item.name: Create a service account for a team.

query.description: (Required) Name is the name of the service account to create.
(Required) PolicyID is the ID of the policy to assign to the service account.

Permissions is whether the service account is read-only or not. Any value besides "read-only" will be treated as "read-write".
Optional.

response.name: CreateTeamServiceAccountResponse contains the created service account and its access token.
